name: cip.tenant.admin
description: Codestra CIP optional product scope (tenant administration) managed by protected Keycloak GitOps. Administer the token tenant's own CIP settings, projects and member role requests. Never cross-tenant, never realm or platform administration. Requested explicitly per short-lived token, issued only to holders of its mapped CIP realm roles, bound to the token tenant_id, and never a realm or client default.
